data.name: Realm Watch
data.detailed_description:
Welcome, chosen hero!

Realm Watch is a wild mix of wave defense and tower building, set in the dark world of Nebrumluminux. Choose your hero, invite your friends in 4-player co-op, and face hordes of mutated, overwhelming enemies that will thrill every fantasy fan.

No one is safe from the falling shimmer - and our roster of enemies will continue to grow.

What has happened so far...

In the world of Realm Watch, humans, orcs, dwarves, the Leifen Elves, and the Ztarben Elves are divided into four factions, each worshipping a great god in the battle for control of Nebrumluminux, a war that has raged since the dawn of recorded history. But on the fateful day of the Shimmerfall, the Four Great Gods - Luxperan, Ascendios, and Umbraeth, Mistress of the Mists - let out agonizing screams.

"Unite the world. Stop slaughtering each other. Ctzaarkhshe has arrived."

Since that day, the gods have fallen silent, and the skies now rain literal pus, madness, and tentacles.

Now, you play as a hero, joining forces with others to seek and recover the gods' lost artifacts, hoping to restore their power... for they have remained silent since the Shimmerfall.

Why Early Access?

We are an ambitious four-person team with a passion for creating games by players, for players. From the start, our game will feature core mechanics - you'll choose a hero, play with friends, build, and battle together. But this is just the beginning. We're already working on in-game art, a detailed lore-rich environment, and an immersive game world filled with monsters. We’re also constantly working to improve the game’s aesthetics to ensure a visually captivating experience. Plus, couch co-op for PC is on the way!

Our vision includes a massive story and campaign where players can dive deeper into the world of Realm Watch. We're exploring roguelite elements and, with enough time, we'll also incorporate RPG elements. Expect to see new levels, enemies, heroes, mini-bosses, and full bosses being added regularly, along with new defense systems. A skill tree is also on the way. Additionally, we are introducing in-game Grimoire, allowing players to collect and read information about the world, characters, and lore as they explore.

As players ourselves, this isn’t just a project—it's a passion and a promise. We're working hard to bring this vision to life, but with a small team, it takes time. That’s why we value every piece of feedback and support from our community. We’ll be closely working with you to make Realm Watch the best it can be.

data.short_description: Realm Watch is a cooperative Top-Down Dark Fantasy defense game where you choose your hero, fortify your defenses, and battle to survive relentless enemy waves. The sky weeps glowing pus - are you ready to defend the realm?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (or higher) 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600k / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specifications may change during development

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
